title: Device Register - request  (firmware -> POST /api/Device/Register)
description: Body built by AgrumyDevice DeviceController::registerDevice() (payload[...] lines). This is the unauthenticated bootstrap call - identity is proven by email + devicePin in the body, NOT by headers. Server model: api.Models.DeviceRegistration.

macAddress.description: Uppercase hex with no separators, from WiFi.macAddress() (e.g. "240AC4040AF8"). Binds to DeviceRegistration.MacAddress; the server also builds DeviceName as "Agrumy_" + macAddress.ToUpper().

email.description: User account e-mail (firmware sends config["userLogin"]). Binds to DeviceRegistration.Email; the server looks the user up by it and checks the PIN.

devicePin.description: The user's single-use device PIN. Firmware sends it as a STRING (char devicePin[8], so at most 7 chars); since roadmap #70 the server generates a 6-char uppercase alphanumeric code (no O/I/0/1), compares case-insensitively, expires it after 24h and consumes it on the first successful registration. The server property is string? (DeviceRegistration.DevicePin).

serviceType.description: Echoed from DeviceDefaults.serviceType (0 http, 1 https, 2 mqtt). Binds to DeviceRegistration.ServiceType; the server stores but does not currently act on it.

$comment: Firmware does NOT send 'servicePoint' in this body (it only uses it as the URL host). The server model has a ServicePoint property that defaults to "api.agrumy.com" when the key is absent, which is why additionalProperties is false here - if the firmware starts sending it, that is a deliberate contract change and this schema should be updated.
